summary: ShowUp.ai v1.5 full backend + UI testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_showup_v15.py with 7 pytest cases covering OpenAI ad-hoc post + poll + image generator. Results: 6 passed, 1 SKIPPED (gpt-image-1 image gen broken upstream — see CRITICAL below). Full regression 96/96 v1.0-v1.4 tests STILL 100% pass (102 passed, 1 skipped total, 209s). Frontend UI verified end-to-end on the live preview URL: login page dark theme renders correctly with hero 'Make people actually show up.' visible, login form has data-testid='login-email-wrap', login flow works (redirects to '/' not '/dashboard' — note for context). Dashboard shows data-testid='kpi-row' with 4 KPI cards in `grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` (correctly responsive). 'New Webinar' opens data-testid='create-webinar-dialog'. WebinarDetail shows data-testid='open-adhoc-btn' which opens data-testid='adhoc-dialog' modal containing all 6 expected testids (adhoc-audience-linkedin, adhoc-audience-circle, adhoc-toggle-poll, adhoc-toggle-image, adhoc-generate, adhoc-result). Generate (image OFF) returns post body (211 chars), 4 hashtags (#edtech #procurement #schoolsales #b2bmarketing), poll question + 4 options, and an enabled adhoc-copy-all button — all within ~10s. Mobile @ 375x812: data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle' visible, clicking opens a full slide-over sidebar with all nav links. KPI grid stays 2-column on mobile (verified via tailwind class).

critical.issue: OpenAI gpt-image-1 image generation is BROKEN. emergentintegrations LlmChat routes the call to v1/chat/completions but gpt-image-1 is only supported on v1/responses. Upstream returns 404: 'This model is only supported in v1/responses and not in v1/chat/completions. Received Model Group=gpt-image-1'. The API does not error — generate_openai_image() catches the exception and returns None, so the endpoint returns 200 with image_url=null. The UI generates text+poll fine, but no image is ever produced when the user toggles 'Generate accompanying image'. THIS IS PRE-EXISTING in /app/backend/openai_gen.py:generate_openai_image() — needs migration to a Responses-API path or use the OpenAI Python SDK directly (client.images.generate(model='gpt-image-1', ...)) instead of LlmChat.send_message_multimodal_response().

integration_issues.issue: Toggling 'Generate accompanying image' (adhoc-toggle-image) and clicking adhoc-generate completes successfully but no image preview is shown — image_url is null in the response because gpt-image-1 is unreachable via the current LlmChat path.

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY: Fix gpt-image-1 image generation in /app/backend/openai_gen.py:generate_openai_image(). LlmChat.with_model('openai','gpt-image-1').send_message_multimodal_response() routes via litellm to v1/chat/completions which gpt-image-1 does not support. Either (a) call the OpenAI Images API directly (POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations or v1/responses with the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY base url), or (b) switch to a chat-completion-compatible image model (e.g., the Gemini Nano Banana path already used in /app/backend/image_gen.py works for the existing social-image endpoint).
LOW: Style the 'AI Quick Post' button (data-testid='open-adhoc-btn') with the burnt-orange fill specified in the v1.5 PRD so it stands out in the WebinarDetail header.
LOW: Replace the native datetime-local picker inside create-webinar-dialog with a shadcn Calendar + time picker for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/openai_gen.py:96 uses chat.with_model('openai','gpt-image-1').with_params(modalities=['image','text']) then calls send_message_multimodal_response. emergentintegrations/litellm currently routes this to /v1/chat/completions which OpenAI no longer supports for gpt-image-1 (it requires /v1/responses or /v1/images/generations). The except-Exception fallback silently swallows the upstream 404 and returns None — masking the bug as 'image_url=null' instead of surfacing a 5xx. Recommend: surface the error to the client with a clear message OR call OpenAI Images API directly via httpx with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY as Bearer token.
/app/backend/routes_delivery.py:154 returns `{**text_data}` spread — this exposes the internal 'image_prompt' field to the API consumer. Acceptable but worth noting.

/app/backend/routes_delivery.py:151-153 has a second update_one with `text_data` and `audience` — when with_image=False this is the only DB write and works correctly. When with_image=True, the prior update_one inside the if-block writes file_id/mime_type/image_bytes first, then this writes text_data — two separate writes, acceptable but could be one $set for atomicity.

Login redirects to '/' (root) not '/dashboard'. Dashboard rendering at root works fine but the system prompt's expected URL pattern '**/dashboard**' fails. Either alias '/dashboard' as a route or update test expectations.
Two pytest @mark.timeout markers in test_showup_v13.py still emit PytestUnknownMarkWarning (cosmetic carryover).

rca of the issue: Image generation root cause: /app/backend/openai_gen.py uses LlmChat.with_model('openai','gpt-image-1').send_message_multimodal_response() which under emergentintegrations/litellm routes the request to OpenAI /v1/chat/completions. OpenAI's gpt-image-1 model has been moved to the new Responses API (/v1/responses) or the dedicated Images API (/v1/images/generations) — it returns HTTP 404 with message 'This model is only supported in v1/responses and not in v1/chat/completions. Received Model Group=gpt-image-1'. The bug surfaces as image_url=null in the API response because the broad except in generate_openai_image() returns None on any exception. Reproduction: POST /api/webinars/{any_wid}/adhoc-post/generate with {audience:'linkedin', with_image:true} — response has image_url:null, backend log shows litellm.BadRequestError. Mitigation options: (1) bypass LlmChat and call OpenAI Images endpoint directly via httpx using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY as Bearer (https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations with body {model:'gpt-image-1', prompt:..., size:'1024x1024', response_format:'b64_json'}); (2) use the existing Nano Banana path in /app/backend/image_gen.py:generate_webinar_social_image which already works for social-image; (3) wait for emergentintegrations to support v1/responses for image models.
